notes: Single application contract PaidVoting (src/PaidVoting.sol, solc 0.8.26, evm_version cancun, optimizer 200 runs, bytecode_hash none). Constructor takes no arguments, is nonpayable, reads no msg.sender, creates no contracts and performs no external calls, so the factory gains no privilege and no $owner argument exists. Deploy with zero ETH; there is no initialization call, token, pool, proxy, DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. Who can call what: no privileged roles. vote() is permissionless and payable: it credits msg.value (at least 1 wei, else ZeroPayment) to msg.sender's cumulative total, increments totalReceived and totalVotes, emits VotePaid(payer, amount, cumulativePaid) and re-ranks the leaderboard. topPayers(uint256 i) for i in 0..2 holds the three addresses with the highest cumulative payments in descending order, address(0) for empty slots; getTopPayers() returns the ordered addresses and their totals. Ranking is by cumulative wei paid across all calls, not call count; equal totals keep the earlier payer, and a newcomer must strictly exceed third place. totalPaid(address) stays recorded for evicted payers so later payments can return them. The contract has no receive or fallback, so plain ETH transfers revert; ETH forced in via SELFDESTRUCT or coinbase is not counted in totalReceived. Upgrades and pausing: none. Outside contracts: none. There is no owner, withdraw, refund, payout or sweep: every wei paid to vote() remains in the contract permanently, and this must be disclosed to users. Target chain must support Cancun opcodes; runtime is well under the EIP-170 limit.
